title: Leading and Managing Vendor Relations
overview: Strong vendor relationships are key to driving business success and profitability. This course provides a comprehensive approach to developing and managing vendor partnerships to enhance overall performance. Participants will learn to assess vendor profiles, apply various go-to-market strategies, and foster effective vendor integration. Additionally, the course will highlight the leadership and communication skills crucial for optimizing vendor relationships and ensuring seamless collaboration.
audience: Ideal for purchasing and supply chain professionals involved in supply management, vendor relations, sourcing, buying, expediting, and vendor evaluation, as well as anyone involved in the procurement process.
methodology: This program utilizes a variety of interactive techniques, including exercises, case studies, questionnaires, and videos to enhance the learning experience.
competencies: Leadership and communication in vendor relations
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Assess and select vendors that align with the organization’s needs and goals
Implement vendor integration strategies to support strategic procurement objectives
Manage vendor performance for continuous improvement and value maximization
Apply strategic go-to-market approaches to boost internal capabilities
Use essential leadership and communication skills to improve vendor relationship outcomes
